findings.title: The Profit Gap is running through your discount line
findings.evidence: 3 of your 18 live products are discounted, averaging 51.9% off. That can hold your revenue while contribution profit slips underneath it. The gap between the two is the first number RISE looks at.

findings.title: No subscribe-and-save path for repeat buyers
findings.evidence: Your storefront runs 18 products with no subscription option we could find on the page. Repeat purchases are where contribution profit compounds, and a subscribe-and-save path turns one-time buyers into predictable revenue on the traffic you already pay for.

findings.title: Your price band is wide and the median sits low
findings.evidence: Catalog runs $5 to $118 with a $20 median. A wide band with a low median makes blended AOV fragile on paid. The lever is threshold and bundle offers on the landing path the ads point to.

findings.title: Paid clicks are landing on sold-out variants
findings.evidence: 39.7% of your variants read out-of-stock right now. Every paid click that hits a sold-out variant is spend with no shot at converting, a direct drag on blended MER.

findings.title: You're not running paid social right now
findings.evidence: The public Meta Ad Library shows zero active ads. For a brand at your catalog depth, that's unclaimed demand, and a cold-audience paid engine is the fastest lever we pull.

findings.title: No visible reviews on the page paid traffic hits
findings.evidence: We couldn't find review markup on your product page. Cold paid traffic converts on social proof, so surfacing reviews on the PDP is a direct conversion lever.
